crude_oil_up.description: Sustained rise in crude oil prices.

benefits.rationale: Higher realisations on the crude and gas they produce.

hurts.rationale: Marketing margins squeezed if retail fuel prices lag crude.
Crude derivatives (solvents, monomers) are key raw materials.
Synthetic rubber and carbon black are crude-linked.
Jet fuel (ATF) is the single largest cost line.
Petrochemical-derived inputs raise costs.
Crude-linked polymer/plastic input costs.

energy_importer_relief.description: India securing discounted crude (e.g. Russian barrels) even as global crude stays firm — a refiner-specific feedstock advantage.

benefits.rationale: Cheaper discounted feedstock widens gross refining margins.
Higher domestic gas realisations.

hurts.rationale: Higher input gas cost pressures CNG/PNG margins.
Volume and petchem-margin pressure from costly gas.
Gas is the primary urea feedstock.

benefits.rationale: Pricing power and inventory gains partly offset higher import costs.

hurts.rationale: Edible oil is a major input; margin pressure.
Cooking-oil cost pressure on food margins.

fertilizer_input_up.description: Fertilizer / gas / potash input costs spike.

hurts.rationale: Input costs rise; margins depend on subsidy pass-through.

wheat_export_window.description: Global grain shortage opens Indian export opportunity.

benefits.rationale: Higher global prices and export demand (subject to govt curbs).
Firm soft-commodity prices and ethanol economics.

defense_indigenization.description: Push to build defense domestically (supply strain or higher spending).

benefits.rationale: Order inflow from import-substitution and higher defense budgets.

defense_exports.description: Rising Indian defense exports (e.g. BrahMos, artillery, components).

benefits.rationale: Export orders add to the domestic order book.

china_plus_one.description: Supply-chain shift away from China (electronics, APIs, chemicals).

benefits.rationale: Domestic API substitution demand.
PLI-backed onshoring of electronics.
Global buyers diversify chemical sourcing to India.

hurts.rationale: Higher input costs during the transition.

benefits.rationale: Onshoring incentives and scarcity value for domestic capacity.

hurts.rationale: Chip shortages throttle vehicle production.
Component scarcity raises costs and delays output.

benefits.rationale: Strategic-minerals push and scarcity value.

hurts.rationale: Rare-earth magnets are critical for EV motors.
Magnets/components rely on rare earths.

shipping_freight_up.description: Freight, insurance and transit costs spike (Red Sea / Hormuz / route disruption).

benefits.rationale: Higher charter and freight rates lift earnings.

hurts.rationale: Higher freight and longer transit erode export competitiveness.
Transit delays and cost inflation squeeze margins.

benefits.rationale: Higher realisations for domestic coal.

hurts.rationale: Higher imported-coal fuel costs.
Coal/pet-coke is a major kiln fuel.

benefits.rationale: Higher gold prices lift inventory value and loan books.

risk_off_rupee_weak.description: Broad risk-off / rupee depreciation from conflict escalation.

benefits.rationale: Dollar revenue gains on a weaker rupee.
Safe-haven demand for gold.

hurts.rationale: Risk aversion and costlier dollar imports.

pharma_generic_demand.description: Supply shocks lift demand for Indian generic pharma / APIs.

benefits.rationale: India as the 'pharmacy of the world' gains share on supply disruptions.

textile_export_gain.description: Disruption at a rival garment hub (e.g. Bangladesh) or a China+1 shift redirects apparel and home-textile orders to India.

benefits.rationale: Global buyers divert orders to Indian garment and home-textile exporters.
